issues.description: Wrong page rendered: Step 3b style blend confirmation screen is expected but Step 1 (room selection) is displayed instead. The URL shows /design/step-2 but the page:mount event fires for step-2 after step-3b, suggesting a redirect/routing loop is sending the user back to step-1 or step-2.
issues.root_cause: Console logs show page:mount firing for step-3b then immediately for step-2 (timestamps 1776404415140 and 1776404415346 — only 206ms apart), indicating a programmatic redirect in step-3b/page.tsx or middleware is bouncing back to step-2. Likely the page guards session/state and if style quiz answers are missing from state/localStorage it redirects back. The hydration error on width (Server: 5%, Client: 15%) on step-3 also suggests SSR state mismatch causing the app to reset flow state.

issues.description: React hydration error: Prop 'style' did not match — Server: 'width:5%' Client: 'width:15%'. The percentage bar width is computed differently on server vs client (likely from Math.random() or uninitialized state), causing full root re-render and potentially corrupting navigation state.
issues.element: Style percentage bar <div> in step-3/page.tsx around line 59
issues.root_cause: In app/design/step-3/page.tsx the style blend percentage bar width is derived from a value that differs between SSR and CSR — e.g. reading from localStorage, using Math.random(), or reading from a Zustand/context store that is not initialized during SSR. This produces width:5% server-side and width:15% client-side.

issues.description: Multiple 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' hydration errors (7 instances). Root switches to full client rendering, which may clear persisted state and trigger redirect guards back to step-1.
issues.element: Multiple text nodes across step-3/page.tsx and step-3b/page.tsx
issues.root_cause: Percentage values and/or style label text rendered directly on the server from uninitialized state (empty string or 0) differ from client-computed values read from store/localStorage after hydration.

issues.description: Style names must be human-readable (e.g. 'Scandinavian', 'Japandi') but if COVA* internal keys leak through the key-to-label mapping on the server render vs client render mismatch, text hydration errors would result and raw keys could flash.
issues.element: Style name text nodes in step-3b
issues.root_cause: Style label lookup likely reads from a map that is populated client-side only (e.g. fetched from API or read from store), so SSR renders the raw key while CSR renders the human label.

issues.description: page:mount fires twice for both step-3b (ts:…140, …143) and step-2 (ts:…346, …346) — double mount and immediate back-navigation indicate the redirect guard in step-3b fires on every render including initial, causing a loop back to step-2 which re-renders step-1 UI.
issues.root_cause: The useEffect redirect guard likely runs before hydration completes or checks a store value that is undefined on first render, treating missing state as 'not ready' and pushing back to /design/step-2.

fixes.reason: Prevents SSR/CSR mismatch on the percentage bar by rendering 0% on server and the real value on client, eliminating the hydration prop mismatch warning. A better long-term fix is to wrap the bar in a client component with suppressHydrationWarning or use useEffect to set the width after mount.
suppressHydrationWarning on the specific bar div suppresses the noisy React warning for this intentional SSR/CSR value difference while the underlying state initialization is fixed.

Guards the redirect until after hydration is complete by gating on a hydrated flag set in a separate useEffect. This prevents the redirect from firing during SSR or before client state is rehydrated from localStorage/store, stopping the redirect loop.

Ensures COVA* internal style keys are always mapped to human-readable names on both server and client, preventing raw keys from being displayed and eliminating text-content hydration mismatches caused by key-to-label resolution differences between SSR and CSR.

If the store is not persisted, state is lost on navigation/hydration and redirect guards fire incorrectly. Wrapping with zustand/middleware persist ensures style blend state survives page transitions and hydration cycles. (Complete the persist wrapper with storage: createJSONStorage(() => localStorage) and the closing parentheses.)
